Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that Ekam – Son Of Soil was released first by relying only on IMDb’s 2011 DVD/TV dates for Farber’s Nerve and ignoring clear indicators that Farber’s Nerve is a 2006 film (shown on IMDb’s title header and in the DuckDuckGo/Wikipedia hints). The Planner also failed to ensure the planned corroboration with Wikipedia was executed before finalizing, leading to comparing 2010 vs 2011 instead of 2010 vs 2006.
